import base64, ctypes as c, io, os, shutil, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from pywinauto import Desktop
from pywinauto.keyboard import send_keys
import psutil

ROOT=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
EXE=ROOT/"out"/"winui"/"Release"/"flyExplorer.exe"
profile=Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"])
aliases={
"Desktop":("Desktop","\ubc14\ud0d5 \ud654\uba74"),
"Documents":("Documents","\ubb38\uc11c"),
"Downloads":("Downloads","\ub2e4\uc6b4\ub85c\ub4dc"),
"Pictures":("Pictures","\uc0ac\uc9c4"),
"Music":("Music","\uc74c\uc545"),
"Videos":("Videos","\ub3d9\uc601\uc0c1"),
}
targets=tuple(aliases)

def until(fn,why,timeout=30):
    end=time.monotonic()+timeout
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        try:
            v=fn()
            if v:return v
        except Exception:
            pass
        time.sleep(.25)
    raise AssertionError(why)

def shot(wrapper):
    img=wrapper.capture_as_image().convert("RGB")
    img.thumbnail((972,720))
    b=io.BytesIO()
    img.save(b,format="JPEG",quality=86,optimize=True)
    return base64.b64encode(b.getvalue()).decode("ascii")

def map_rows(items):
    found={}
    for item in items:
        try:name=item.element_info.name or item.window_text()
        except Exception:continue
        for key,names in aliases.items():
            if any(alias in name for alias in names):
                found.setdefault(key,(item,name))
                break
    return found

owned=ROOT/"logs"/"known-folder-artwork-owned"
if owned.exists():shutil.rmtree(owned)
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer").mkdir(parents=True)
(owned/"appdata").mkdir()
(owned/"temp").mkdir()
(owned/"localappdata"/"flyExplorer"/"ui-preferences-v1.txt").write_text(
    "schema=2\r\nlanguage=ko-KR\r\ntheme=dark\r\nview=large-icons\r\n",
    encoding="ascii",newline="")
env=os.environ.copy()
env["LOCALAPPDATA"]=str(owned/"localappdata")
env["APPDATA"]=str(owned/"appdata")
env["TEMP"]=env["TMP"]=str(owned/"temp")

app=subprocess.Popen([str(EXE),str(profile)],cwd=EXE.parent,env=env)
appw=None
try:
    def app_window():
        if app.poll() is not None:return None
        ws=[w for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(process=app.pid)
            if "flyExplorer" in w.window_text()]
        return ws[0] if len(ws)==1 else None
    appw=until(app_window,"flyExplorer window missing")
    try:appw.move_window(x=40,y=40,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
    except Exception:pass
    def app_rows():
        files=[x for x in appw.descendants()
               if x.element_info.automation_id=="LeftFiles"]
        if len(files)!=1:return None
        rows=map_rows([x for x in files[0].descendants()
                      if x.element_info.control_type=="ListItem"])
        return rows if len(rows)==6 else None
    rows=until(app_rows,"flyExplorer six Known Folder rows missing",30)
    time.sleep(1)
    print("FLY_KNOWN_FOLDER_COUNT",len(rows),flush=True)
    for key in targets:
        item,name=rows[key]
        imgs=[x for x in item.descendants()
              if x.element_info.control_type=="Image" and
                 x.element_info.name=="Windows Known Folder artwork"]
        r=item.rectangle()
        ir=imgs[0].rectangle() if imgs else None
        print("FLY_KNOWN_FOLDER_ROW",key,repr(name),
              "ROW",(r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height()),
              "ARTWORK_IMAGES",len(imgs),
              "IMAGE",None if ir is None else (ir.left,ir.top,ir.width(),ir.height()),
              flush=True)
        if len(imgs)!=1:raise AssertionError(f"{key}: artwork count {len(imgs)}")
    print("FLY_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN",flush=True)
    print(shot(appw),flush=True)
    print("FLY_SCREENSHOT_END",flush=True)
finally:
    if app.poll() is None:
        if appw:
            c.windll.user32.PostMessageW(appw.handle,0x10,0,0)
            try:app.wait(timeout=10)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                app.terminate();app.wait(timeout=8)
        else:
            app.terminate();app.wait(timeout=8)
print("FLY_PROCESS_EXIT",app.returncode,flush=True)

before=set()
for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(control_type="Window"):
    try:
        if psutil.Process(w.element_info.process_id).name().lower()=="explorer.exe":
            before.add(w.handle)
    except Exception:pass
subprocess.Popen(["explorer.exe","/separate,",str(profile)])
exp=None
try:
    def exp_window():
        for w in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(control_type="Window"):
            try:
                if w.handle in before:continue
                if psutil.Process(w.element_info.process_id).name().lower()=="explorer.exe":
                    return w
            except Exception:pass
        return None
    exp=until(exp_window,"Explorer window missing",20)
    try:exp.move_window(x=40,y=40,width=972,height=720,repaint=True)
    except Exception:pass
    exp.set_focus()
    send_keys("^+2")
    time.sleep(1.5)
    def exp_rows():
        rows=map_rows([x for x in exp.descendants()
                      if x.element_info.control_type=="ListItem"])
        return rows if len(rows)==6 else None
    erows=until(exp_rows,"Explorer six Known Folder rows missing",20)
    print("EXPLORER_KNOWN_FOLDER_COUNT",len(erows),flush=True)
    for key in targets:
        item,name=erows[key]
        r=item.rectangle()
        print("EXPLORER_KNOWN_FOLDER_ROW",key,repr(name),
              "ROW",(r.left,r.top,r.width(),r.height()),flush=True)
    print("EXPLORER_SCREENSHOT_BEGIN",flush=True)
    print(shot(exp),flush=True)
    print("EXPLORER_SCREENSHOT_END",flush=True)
finally:
    if exp:
        try:exp.close()
        except Exception:pass
